{{Quote|Who the heck are you??|Mahar Spince's last words|<ref name="SWG:MPwN" />}}
'''Mahar Spince''' was a henchman of [[Nym/Legends|Nym's]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In an attempt to reconcile their differences, and convince Nym to help the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] tasked a Rebel operative with finding and [[Death/Legends|killing]] Spince, who had by then betrayed the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] by helping the [[Blood Razors]] steal their munitions.<ref name="SWG:MPwN" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mahar Spince was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MPwN" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mahar Spince was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Rebel Theme Park|Rebel Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:MPwN" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
